Privacy Policy
Draft template. Fill in the bracketed parts and have a lawyer review this before public launch.
Last updated: [DATE]

What we collect. A username and password (your password is hashed and stored by our authentication provider (we never see it)), an optional email address (used only for password recovery), an optional profile picture you upload, your gameplay stats (scores, games played, accuracy), and the content of any questions or reports you submit.

How we use it. To run your account, save your progress, show leaderboards, and let you recover a lost password. We do not sell your personal data.

Where it's stored. Your data is held by our backend provider, Supabase, which processes it on our behalf. See [Supabase's privacy policy / link].

Children. Anime Sekai is not directed to and not intended for use by children under 13 (or the minimum age in your country). We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us data, contact us and we'll delete it.

Your rights. You can permanently delete your account and all associated data at any time from your profile menu. To request a copy of your data or ask a privacy question, contact us below.

Contact. [your-contact-email]

You must not submit content that is unlawful, infringing, hateful, harassing, or otherwise objectionable. We review submissions and may remove content or suspend accounts at our discretion.

5. Anime imagery. Anime Sekai is a fan-made project. Anime titles, characters and images referenced in questions are the property of their respective copyright owners; we claim no ownership. If you are a rights holder and want content removed, contact us and we will respond promptly. [Designate a DMCA agent here.]
